whole_before.body: --- title: "Attica — Athena, Poseidon, Cecrops, Olive, Sea, Verdict, and the Remembered Counter-Claim" record_id: mytheme-myth-attica-athena-poseidon-cecrops record_type: whole-mytheme register: mytheme domain: myth status: developed-whole claim_status: Argued source_relation: "Authored amplification; distinct selected telling and material witnesses" world: hellenic geography: "Attica and the Athenian Acropolis; Roman/Latin receptions separately identified" time: "Mythic Cecropian reign; ancient material and literary witnesses; Taylor 2026 reception remain distinct" development_status: writer-complete-parent-T22-and-source-foldback-pending human_amplification: relation-local source_readiness: selected-witnesses-recovered-parent-source-house-foldback-pending --- # Attica — Athena, Poseidon, Cecrops, Olive, Sea, Verdict, and the Remembered Counter-Claim ## #0 — A city named, a place still answering Athena wins the city’s name; Poseidon’s sign remains in its sacred centre. The Attica whole carries the relation between a civic determination that genuinely governs and the contrary it cannot make unreal. Its sea, olive, witness, arbiters, naming and aftermath belong to one relational image before any figure is amplified separately. Taylor’s toroidal appointment and olive chain develop that image in the Mytheme register. The [direct reconciliation](../../../../../../../working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/NATIVE-020-DEEP-SEAM-RECONCILIATION.md) **grounds** this exact office, while the [tree-seam carrier](../../../../../../../working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/ETYMOLOGICAL-ARCHAEOLOGY-TREE-SEAMS.md) **extends** the gift through its authored material chain. Their separate source and human-amplification standings continue through the whole. ## #1 — Claim, witness, verdict and flood ### Pseudo-Apollodorus, *Library* 3.14.1 — the complete contest The telling begins with **Cecrops**, first king of Attica, described as a son of the soil with a body compounded of man and serpent. The land has already entered a naming history: the country formerly called Acte is named Cecropia after him. The gods then seek cities in which each will receive a peculiar worship. **Poseidon arrives first**. He strikes the **middle of the Acropolis** with his trident and produces a sea, called Erechtheis in the telling. **Athena arrives after him**. She calls **Cecrops to witness** her act of taking possession and plants an **olive tree**. The two gods strive for possession of the country. **Zeus separates them and appoints arbiters**; in this version the arbiters are the twelve gods. The country is awarded to Athena because Cecrops bears witness that she planted the olive. Athena calls the city **Athens after herself**. The verdict does not dissolve Poseidon's force. In anger he floods the Thriasian plain and lays Attica under the sea. This source sequence must remain available before any symbolic abstraction: ```text earth-born serpent-human king / prior naming ↓ divine claims upon a place ↓ Poseidon arrives first trident → middle of Acropolis → sea ↓ Athena arrives calls Cecrops as witness → plants olive ↓ conflict ↓ Zeus separates ↓ arbitration ↓ Cecrops's testimony ↓ verdict for Athena ↓ Athens receives Athena's name ↓ Poseidon's flood / unresolved aftermath ``` The [selected Frazer digital text, 3.14.1](https://www.theoi.com/Text/Apollodorus3.html) **sources** this sequence. Its explicit distinction between the twelve divine arbiters and Cecrops’s witnessing matters: the city’s adjudication is not simply the king choosing a favourite gift. The text gives his testimony to Athena’s planting as the stated ground of the award; the olive’s later material transformations belong to the authored amplification below. ## #2 — Variant aftermaths and material memory ### Hyginus — the flood prevented In [*Fabulae* 164](https://cal.byu.edu/macfarlane/OGCMA/AthenaANCIENT_Hyginus.htm), Neptune and Minerva submit the city-founding contest to Jupiter. Minerva wins through planting the first olive. Neptune intends to inundate the land, but Mercury prevents him on Jupiter’s orders; Minerva then founds Athens in her own name. The telling calls it the first city established in the land. This **qualifies** the Pseudo-Apollodoran aftermath: here higher authority intervenes again and restrains the defeated claimant’s force. Neither Mercury’s intervention nor the single divine judge belongs inside the twelve-god version. The selected English witness is Roger T. Macfarlane’s translation; a separate [Latin text of 164](https://lateinlex.de/?call=Puc&permalink=Hyg_fab_164) confirms the prevented inundation. ### Augustine’s Varro-derived account — the victors punished [Augustine, *City of God* 18.9](https://www.logoslibrary.org/augustine/city/1809.html), **sources** a different sequence. An olive and water appear; Cecrops consults Delphi, whose response leaves the naming to the citizens. Both sexes vote. The women outnumber the men by one and choose Minerva; the men choose Neptune. Neptune devastates the land. To appease him, the women lose their votes, the right to give children maternal names, and the designation Athenian. Augustine presses the reversal: the goddess whose voters won cannot protect them. He treats the quarrel as demonic mockery. This is his polemical use of a narrative attributed to Varro, not independent evidence that Athenian women historically acquired and then lost these rights. The whole keeps that burden with this witness. ### The Parthenon’s monumental contest The west pediment gives the contest a monumental civic image in which local kings, heroes and river-personifications surround the two divine claimants. The [Acropolis Museum’s Poseidon record, Ακρ. 885](https://www.theacropolismuseum.gr/en/node/23827), **sources** its 437–432 BCE dating and **qualifies** the reconstruction: Poseidon’s trident action can be read as withdrawing it after creating the spring or striking to flood the city. The museum’s local-hero judging account remains its interpretation of the sculptural field; it is not substituted for Pseudo-Apollodorus’s tribunal. Monument, reconstructed scene and literary narrative remain different witnesses. ### The sanctuary remembers both claims The [Acropolis Museum’s Erechtheion account](https://www.theacropolismuseum.gr/en/node/16472) **sources** the historical-cultic continuation. The Erechtheion's eastern room was dedicated to Athena, while its lower western room accommodated shrines including **Poseidon-Erechtheus**. The complex also incorporated the sacred signs associated with the contest: Athena's olive, Poseidon's trident marks in the bedrock, and the spring of salty water associated with his strike. This does not belong to the narrative sequence as another mythic episode. It is a later material memory of the whole contest. The victorious civic form retains the counter-claim inside its sacred architecture. ### Herodotus and Pausanias — witnesses within a surviving place [Herodotus 8.55](https://lexundria.com/hdt/8.55/mcly) **sources** the Athenians’ report of olive and sea as the gods’ witnesses in Erechtheus’s sanctuary. After its burning, sacrificial visitors report a shoot about a cubit long on the next day. The sanctuary in this narrative precedes the later Erechtheion described by the museum; these are not automatically one unchanged building. [Pausanias 1.26.5–7 and 1.27.2](https://sourcebooks.web.fordham.edu/ancient/pausanias-bk1.asp) **sources** another view: altars for Poseidon with Erechtheus, Butes and Hephaestus, a sea-water cistern, its reported wave-sound in a south wind, and a trident mark accompany Athena’s continuing civic honour. His olive-regrowth legend gives two cubits on the day of burning. That timing and height remain distinct from Herodotus’s report. The sacred place retains the rival signs in these witnesses; their coexistence supplies the material relation Taylor receives. Pausanias also describes an oil-fed lamp. This is a separate cultic object, not evidence that the contest olive supplied its oil or that the source taught the full root-to-light chain. The selected online witnesses above are recovered for parent source-house foldback. They make the source sequence inspectable now; canonical passage installation and selected-print collation remain separate work. No mythic action is asserted as an independently established historical event. ## #3 — The ratified sea-depth and olive The following relations have already been supplied or ratified by Frank and may be treated as **current authorial amplification**. ### 3.1 Poseidon's well / sea as the archaic-magical depth retained at the centre **human-amplified: yes** **provenance:** Frank; system may articulate and source **relation:** Poseidon's sea/well is read as the archaic, magical, unconscious or pre-rational depth that is **enshrined within the heart of Athena/Minerva's rational-civic form**, not merely superseded by it. The strongest image is toroidal rather than linear. Athena's civic-rational order is not a later layer that leaves Poseidon behind in a dead past. The formed city is organised **around an opening/depth it cannot convert into itself**. Poseidon's sea remains a living interior contrary: watery, affective, archaic, mobile, prior to the clean civic surface and yet materially retained within it. In the project's established language, the whole can therefore image `#0` as an unobjectifiable/archaic-magical depth retained within the differentiated rational field. The point is not that Poseidon “equals #0” as a dictionary key. It is that **the whole city-image holds a governing rational determination together with the depth that determination cannot exhaust**. This is why the Erechtheion continuation matters so strongly to us. The sacred centre does not behave as though Athena's verdict made Poseidon unreal. The city whose name carries Athena materially remembers the sea-sign of the defeated claimant. ### 3.2 Minerva/Athena as rational-civic differentiation rather than total reason **human-amplified: yes** **provenance:** Frank; system articulation **relation:** Athena/Minerva carries the rational, strategic, civic and technical differentiation through which a polity becomes articulate, ordered and self-conscious. The important qualification is already built into the whole: Athena's rationality is **healthy insofar as it can contain relation to what it did not become**. The story is not an anti-rational myth in which Poseidon possesses the deeper truth and Athena is merely the fall. Athena actually wins; the city is genuinely named through her; her gift is genuinely instituted. The danger would lie in a later psychic/civic reading in which the winning determination declared the whole field identical with itself. The retained Poseidon-sign prevents that closure. ### 3.3 The torus with Poseidon's well at its centre **human-amplified: yes** **provenance:** Frank **relation:** the Attic sacred/civic field can be held as a toroidal image: differentiated surface/order wound around an unfilled depth, with Poseidon's well/sea marking the archaic-magical centre that Athena's rationality does not abolish. This is a project-composed image, not an attribution to ancient Athenians. It belongs beside the mature torus/Ouroboros field in Native 020. The gain is precise: the rational/civic form becomes whole **through relation to an interior absence/depth**, not by filling that depth with its own image. The myth therefore gives lived-image form to a central Symbolon theorem: > **the condition of the whole may remain present without becoming one more positive content of the governing form.** ### 3.4 The olive chain **human-amplified: yes** **provenance:** Frank **relation:** Athena's gift carries the authored symbolic chain: ```text root → tree → fruit → pressing → oil → anointing → flame / light ``` The chain is materially grounded rather than merely verbal. The olive roots into earth, persists through seasons and generations, bears fruit, and becomes useful through cultivation and transformation. Pressing releases oil; oil nourishes, anoints and burns; the fruit of rooted life can become light. Inside this story the chain acquires a political/psychic office it would not have as a free-standing “tree symbol”: **this is the gift through which Athena's claim is witnessed, preferred and made civic**. The living/cultivated form becomes part of the polity's chosen self-image. The chain may later open into Epi-Logos technē, but that further appointment is not yet automatically included merely because Athena is a goddess of craft. ### 3.5 A valid verdict is not an exhaustive ontology **human-amplified: yes** **provenance:** Frank's arbitration/Hybris field + Attica significance; system formulation **relation:** Athena's victory is a real determination; Poseidon's retained presence shows that determination need not make the contrary unreal. This is one of the Attica story's strongest joins to the established Arbitration sixfold. A judgment can bind. A city can receive a name. A civic orientation can become dominant. **Hybris begins when the achieved determination retroactively claims that what it did not choose never belonged to the field.** The Attic whole refuses that simplification. The city is Athena's and also remains a place in which Poseidon's sign, cult and force have standing. The myth can therefore carry the formulation: > **the verdict determines the city; it does not exhaust the place.** and, in the language of the current historical archaeology: > **a name can be valid without being the whole character of what it names.** ## #4 — The psychic whole and its shared relation The Jungian/Symbolon reading begins from the **whole psychic drama**, not a list of god-equivalences. The story gives a field in which a place is claimed by differentiated powers, each makes a material sign, an autochthonous witness mediates what has happened, a higher arbitration establishes a conscious/civic determination, the polity takes a name, the unchosen power returns, and later cultic form retains both sides. The fundamental project question is therefore not “what does Poseidon mean?” It is: > **What kind of psychic and civic whole is formed when Athena's determination wins the name of the city while Poseidon's sea remains in its sacred centre?** That question is already native to the project's Symbolon relation: a successful `1` may become explicit and governing without exhausting the `0`/ground from which the whole relation remains alive. The present human-amplified relations already permit a much richer Jungian reading than a dry “Athena = reason / Poseidon = instinct” opposition. The **psychic subject of the story is the whole Attic field**. Athena and Poseidon are agencies or powers within that whole. The symbolic question is how a differentiated conscious/civic orientation arises without severing itself from the archaic-magical depth that remains constitutive of the psyche. Poseidon's water makes the depth **mobile rather than inert**. It is not dead substrate. It can surge, flood, sound and re-enter. Athena's olive makes conscious/civic differentiation **living rather than merely abstract**: rooted, cultivated, fruitful, transmissible, transformable into nourishment, anointing and light. The two signs are therefore not just rival “objects.” They dramatise different modes by which the underlying world becomes present to the emerging polity. The arbitration gives the conscious field a real orientation. Individuation does not require the ego or conscious function to refuse every determination; a psyche incapable of choosing would never become a life. The Symbolon problem is whether the chosen orientation can remain related to its unchosen depths. The later cultic coexistence of Athena and Poseidon makes this relation visible at the level of civic image. The rational-civic achievement does not become integral by dissolving back into Poseidon's sea, and it does not become whole by pretending the sea is gone. **Wholeness is the maintained relation between differentiated civic form and the depth it cannot assimilate.** This is also why the user's toroidal appointment is more exact than a simple “integration of opposites.” A torus has a formed surface organised by an opening that is not another patch of surface. The Poseidon-well image lets the psyche/city remember that its explicit order is organised around something it does not positively contain. ### Shared archetypal structuration, situated Attic whole The [Neumann whole](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md) **grounds** the shared relation of genesis, differentiation, contrary powers and return. A world acquires distinguishable powers and an effective centre; the centre’s achieved orientation continues to depend on relations it cannot exhaust. Attica gives that movement its own body through competing claims upon a place, witnessed signs, a binding decision and the sacred retention of the counter-claim. **Human-amplified: yes** for this shared structuration under the programme and for the five local appointments above. It supplies neither a new parentage for Athena and Poseidon nor a historical claim that the Attic telling arose from Neumann’s twentieth-century psychology. [Taylor’s native core](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **grounds** the whole field in which the civic image is read: `/ = −/−`, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, `1/0`. Relation precedes the named contestants; conscious circumstance becomes question and assertion; force acquires pattern; the pattern enters personed context; exact determination retains a horizon and returns toward its condition. The harmonics and complementary folds keep these operations mutually implicated. The tale’s figures remain participants in their own narrative, rather than assignments to eight slots. In particular, `X/x` remains Taylor’s determining-capacity/indefinite-particular relation; a Jungian reception does not own the notation. The [Neumann source house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/SOURCE.md) **compares** its mythic-psychological morphology. Its protected NOTES carries Taylor’s whole-field encounter, with quotations still awaiting collation. [Aion](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) **qualifies** attribution to Jung: exact water/unconscious and amplification passages remain unrecovered in this house. The present psychic development follows the expressly ratified Attica appointments; it does not claim to quote Jung’s interpretation of the contest. The toroidal reading retains its precise scale. Poseidon’s well gives the civic image an interior depth; the formal torus’s opening is not itself a well filled with water. Taylor’s image carries the relation between formed order and its unassimilated condition. The [uroboros whole](../../../archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md) **compares** the already developed round, opening and circulation through its own complete drama. The Attic appointment does not change that whole’s distinction between Māyā’s measure and the unobjectifiable opening, or turn a material sanctuary into a proof of topology. ## #5→0 — The verdict returns to the place The whole **returns-to** [A24, Arbitration and the Usurpation of Measure](../../../../episteme/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md), through the real competence of a verdict whose consequence remains within a larger field. Witness, tribunal and civic naming each do something definite. Retaining Poseidon’s sign does not revoke Athena’s award. The authored relation distinguishes a decision that binds from the further claim that its result exhausts the place. **Human-amplified: yes** for this ratified return. The [Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis whole-field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** this return at operational register 3. Continuity-in-Indeterminacy keeps the place’s prior and continuing relations available. Criterion-through-Distinction and Delineation-through-Difference expose what counts in the judgment and the field over which it acts. Arbitration-in-Crisis gives the conflict a binding determination. Con-text-through-Diaphaneity lets that determination be seen together with its contrary and consequences. Resolution-in-Reconciliation returns an achieved civic orientation with its history. Regard and anamnesis flower from these generated relations. They neither turn the flood into an already ratified compensation-image nor assert a Greek lexical derivation from the myth. ### Geography and time Attica, the Acropolis, the Thriasian plain and the sanctuary precinct remain distinct places within the account. The mythic reign of Cecrops gives the telling its time of action; it does not date the surviving literary witnesses. Herodotus’s account of the burning, the late-fifth-century material monuments, Pausanias’s visit, the Greek mythographic telling, the Latin variants and modern museum interpretation have their own temporal and evidential offices. Taylor’s 2026 reception gathers them through the retained-contrary relation. That gathering supplies no transmission chain between witnesses and no chronology in which Athena simply replaces Poseidon as an obsolete stage of mind. ### Source foldback and held amplification The seven prospective source houses and eight exact passage-card proposals are saved in the private completion packet for parent foldback. The whole’s ancient/material additions use the selected witnesses linked above and retain their stated limits. Its source-house installation debt therefore remains precise; its **Argued** authorial standing is unchanged. The five `human-amplified: no` candidates below have been preserved as candidates, without being promoted by source recovery. The Attica whole should remain recoverable when any later register consumes one of its operations. ### Arbitration The story gives a complete image of **difference → witness → judgment → instituted consequence → remainder**. It therefore amplifies [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/HISTORY|Arbitration, Hybris, Regard, and Anamnesis]] without being reduced to that sixfold. ### Fides / Topos / Logos / Nomos / Natio / Credere The whole is especially close to the `Topos → Logos → Nomos → Natio` historical fourfold: ```text Topos Attica / Acropolis as claimed place Logos rival signs, testimony, naming Nomos divine arbitration / verdict / civic institution Natio Athens as named civic belonging ``` The relation is analogical/operational, not a claim that the myth encoded the later etymological sixfold. ### Name / character / act Athena's name becomes the civic noun; Poseidon's continued force shows that the noun does not exhaust the living character of the place. This makes Attica a future Mytheme neighbour of the Name/Act archaeology: **what the polity is called and what continues to act within it need not coincide exhaustively**. ### Ouroboros / torus / hidden zero The human-amplified Poseidon-well image belongs beside the toroidal whole: explicit form around an unfilled condition; the centre/depth remains constitutive without becoming governing surface-content. ### Technē Athena's olive opens an eventual route into living technē: cultivated form, transformation, nourishment and light. This route is **partially human-amplified** through the olive chain; its exact Epi-Logos technical appointment remains open until human amplification is complete. ### Five held amplification candidates The following relations are deliberately retained as **`human-amplified: no`**. They are not rejected; they are candidate amplifications that the system should present back to Frank rather than silently install as authored meaning. #### 5.1 Cecrops as psychoid mediator **human-amplified: no** **system candidate:** Cecrops's earth-born, serpent-human form may image a mediator between chthonic ground and emergent human-civic consciousness. His capacity to witness both divine signs would then be inseparable from his double nature: the witness of the civic decision is himself still continuous with the soil and serpent-depth of the place. **Why it needs human amplification:** this is a powerful Jungian/psychoid reading, but Frank has not yet explicitly appointed Cecrops to that office. It should be brought for encounter, not propagated as settled canon. #### 5.2 The sea-sign and olive as two modes of power **human-amplified: no** **system candidate:** Poseidon's strike may figure eruptive elemental potency — immediate, vertical, forceful, oceanic — while Athena's olive figures cultivated power — rooted, temporal, generative, technical and socially renewable. The contest would then concern not “nature versus reason” but two modes through which power becomes inhabitable. **Why it needs human amplification:** the opposition is strongly suggested by the whole and by the olive work, but the exact polarity and its QL office have not been ratified. #### 5.3 The flood as return of excluded psychic force **human-amplified: no** **system candidate:** Poseidon's flood after the verdict may be read Jungianly as the return of a rejected/unintegrated power: conscious arbitration can establish an orientation without thereby removing the affective/archetypal energy of the contrary, which may return catastrophically when excluded from the account. **Why it needs human amplification:** this resembles compensation/enantiodromia and fits the project's historical argument about repressed conditions returning, but it should not be converted into the story's official psychology before Frank has worked it. #### 5.4 Cecrops's first naming and Athena's second naming **human-amplified: no** **system candidate:** the story contains **two naming events** before any later abstraction: Cecrops names the prior land Cecropia; Athena later names the city Athens after herself. This may offer an unusually rich Name archaeology in which autochthonous/human kingship and divine/civic patronage successively rename one place without either name exhausting its deeper continuity. **Why it needs human amplification:** this is directly relevant to the emerging name/count/account work, but its symbolic office should be developed with the name unit rather than pre-decided here. #### 5.5 Erechtheion as a historical complexio oppositorum **human-amplified: no** **system candidate:** the historical cultic architecture may be read as a civic *complexio oppositorum*: the conscious city houses the victorious goddess and the defeated sea-god together, including both rival signs. **Why it needs human amplification:** the archaeological facts are source-bearing; “complexio oppositorum” is our later interpretive appointment and needs explicit human assent before becoming a Mytheme theorem. ### Retained whole-story method This is the first worked exemplar of the project's **whole-story-first Mytheme form**. The primary carrier is not Athena, Poseidon, the olive, the serpent, the well, the city-name or arbitration in isolation. It is the complete relational image through which those terms acquire their local offices together. The record distinguishes three things at every stage: 1. **source recovery** — what the ancient telling or historical cultic setting gives; 2. **human-amplified relation** — a symbolic/Jungian/Symbolon reading Frank has supplied or explicitly ratified; 3. **system amplification candidate** — a relation the system can see and formulate, but which remains provisional until Frank has amplified or ratified it. For every project interpretation, the boolean is literal: - `human-amplified: yes` — Frank has supplied or ratified the interpretive relation. The system may deepen, source and cross-link it, but may not silently change its office. - `human-amplified: no` — the interpretation is a system-generated candidate. It may be retained as an amplification prompt, but it may not propagate as current authorial truth until Frank has engaged it. Source facts do **not** use this flag; they are governed by their source/claim status instead. A whole-story Mytheme should now be able to carry, in one addressable record: ```text SOURCE WHOLE telling · variants · material/historical continuation ↓ RELATIONAL SCENE every materially active figure / object / place / action / aftermath ↓ HUMAN AMPLIFICATION LEDGER human-amplified: yes/no on every interpretive edge ↓ JUNGIAN / SYMBOLONIC AMPLIFICATION only ratified edges treated as current authorial field ↓ SYSTEM AMPLIFICATION QUEUE promising but unratified readings kept visible without canonisation ↓ CROSS-REGISTER ROUTES Matheme · Episteme · etymology · argument · history · section ↓ DERIVED INDEXES figure · animal · plant · element · object · motif ↓ CROSS-WHOLE ARCHETYPE only after several intact wholes can be compared ↺ RETURN TO THIS WHOLE ``` This makes the Mytheme register both **human-authored and system-deepenable**. The system can recover sources, detect relations, propose amplifications and build cross-whole indexes; the boolean prevents those abilities from substituting for the human symbolic encounter that gives the project's interpretive work its actual provenance.

The ratified sea-depth and olive

The following relations have already been supplied or ratified by Frank and may be treated as **current authorial amplification**.

### 3.1 Poseidon's well / sea as the archaic-magical depth retained at the centre

**human-amplified: yes**  
**provenance:** Frank; system may articulate and source  
**relation:** Poseidon's sea/well is read as the archaic, magical, unconscious or pre-rational depth that is **enshrined within the heart of Athena/Minerva's rational-civic form**, not merely superseded by it.

The strongest image is toroidal rather than linear. Athena's civic-rational order is not a later layer that leaves Poseidon behind in a dead past. The formed city is organised **around an opening/depth it cannot convert into itself**. Poseidon's sea remains a living interior contrary: watery, affective, archaic, mobile, prior to the clean civic surface and yet materially retained within it.

In the project's established language, the whole can therefore image `#0` as an unobjectifiable/archaic-magical depth retained within the differentiated rational field. The point is not that Poseidon “equals #0” as a dictionary key. It is that **the whole city-image holds a governing rational determination together with the depth that determination cannot exhaust**.

This is why the Erechtheion continuation matters so strongly to us. The sacred centre does not behave as though Athena's verdict made Poseidon unreal. The city whose name carries Athena materially remembers the sea-sign of the defeated claimant.

### 3.2 Minerva/Athena as rational-civic differentiation rather than total reason

**human-amplified: yes**  
**provenance:** Frank; system articulation  
**relation:** Athena/Minerva carries the rational, strategic, civic and technical differentiation through which a polity becomes articulate, ordered and self-conscious.

The important qualification is already built into the whole: Athena's rationality is **healthy insofar as it can contain relation to what it did not become**. The story is not an anti-rational myth in which Poseidon possesses the deeper truth and Athena is merely the fall. Athena actually wins; the city is genuinely named through her; her gift is genuinely instituted.

The danger would lie in a later psychic/civic reading in which the winning determination declared the whole field identical with itself. The retained Poseidon-sign prevents that closure.

### 3.3 The torus with Poseidon's well at its centre

**human-amplified: yes**  
**provenance:** Frank  
**relation:** the Attic sacred/civic field can be held as a toroidal image: differentiated surface/order wound around an unfilled depth, with Poseidon's well/sea marking the archaic-magical centre that Athena's rationality does not abolish.

This is a project-composed image, not an attribution to ancient Athenians. It belongs beside the mature torus/Ouroboros field in Native 020. The gain is precise: the rational/civic form becomes whole **through relation to an interior absence/depth**, not by filling that depth with its own image.

The myth therefore gives lived-image form to a central Symbolon theorem:

> **the condition of the whole may remain present without becoming one more positive content of the governing form.**

### 3.4 The olive chain

**human-amplified: yes**  
**provenance:** Frank  
**relation:** Athena's gift carries the authored symbolic chain:

```text
root → tree → fruit → pressing → oil → anointing → flame / light
```

The chain is materially grounded rather than merely verbal. The olive roots into earth, persists through seasons and generations, bears fruit, and becomes useful through cultivation and transformation. Pressing releases oil; oil nourishes, anoints and burns; the fruit of rooted life can become light.

Inside this story the chain acquires a political/psychic office it would not have as a free-standing “tree symbol”: **this is the gift through which Athena's claim is witnessed, preferred and made civic**. The living/cultivated form becomes part of the polity's chosen self-image.

The chain may later open into Epi-Logos technē, but that further appointment is not yet automatically included merely because Athena is a goddess of craft.

### 3.5 A valid verdict is not an exhaustive ontology

**human-amplified: yes**  
**provenance:** Frank's arbitration/Hybris field + Attica significance; system formulation  
**relation:** Athena's victory is a real determination; Poseidon's retained presence shows that determination need not make the contrary unreal.

This is one of the Attica story's strongest joins to the established Arbitration sixfold. A judgment can bind. A city can receive a name. A civic orientation can become dominant. **Hybris begins when the achieved determination retroactively claims that what it did not choose never belonged to the field.**

The Attic whole refuses that simplification. The city is Athena's and also remains a place in which Poseidon's sign, cult and force have standing.

The myth can therefore carry the formulation:

> **the verdict determines the city; it does not exhaust the place.**

and, in the language of the current historical archaeology:

> **a name can be valid without being the whole character of what it names.**

The following relations are deliberately retained as **`human-amplified: no`**. They are not rejected; they are candidate amplifications that the system should present back to Frank rather than silently install as authored meaning.

#### 5.1 Cecrops as psychoid mediator

**human-amplified: no**  
**system candidate:** Cecrops's earth-born, serpent-human form may image a mediator between chthonic ground and emergent human-civic consciousness. His capacity to witness both divine signs would then be inseparable from his double nature: the witness of the civic decision is himself still continuous with the soil and serpent-depth of the place.

**Why it needs human amplification:** this is a powerful Jungian/psychoid reading, but Frank has not yet explicitly appointed Cecrops to that office. It should be brought for encounter, not propagated as settled canon.

#### 5.2 The sea-sign and olive as two modes of power

**human-amplified: no**  
**system candidate:** Poseidon's strike may figure eruptive elemental potency — immediate, vertical, forceful, oceanic — while Athena's olive figures cultivated power — rooted, temporal, generative, technical and socially renewable. The contest would then concern not “nature versus reason” but two modes through which power becomes inhabitable.

**Why it needs human amplification:** the opposition is strongly suggested by the whole and by the olive work, but the exact polarity and its QL office have not been ratified.

#### 5.3 The flood as return of excluded psychic force

**human-amplified: no**  
**system candidate:** Poseidon's flood after the verdict may be read Jungianly as the return of a rejected/unintegrated power: conscious arbitration can establish an orientation without thereby removing the affective/archetypal energy of the contrary, which may return catastrophically when excluded from the account.

**Why it needs human amplification:** this resembles compensation/enantiodromia and fits the project's historical argument about repressed conditions returning, but it should not be converted into the story's official psychology before Frank has worked it.

#### 5.4 Cecrops's first naming and Athena's second naming

**human-amplified: no**  
**system candidate:** the story contains **two naming events** before any later abstraction: Cecrops names the prior land Cecropia; Athena later names the city Athens after herself. This may offer an unusually rich Name archaeology in which autochthonous/human kingship and divine/civic patronage successively rename one place without either name exhausting its deeper continuity.

**Why it needs human amplification:** this is directly relevant to the emerging name/count/account work, but its symbolic office should be developed with the name unit rather than pre-decided here.

#### 5.5 Erechtheion as a historical complexio oppositorum

**human-amplified: no**  
**system candidate:** the historical cultic architecture may be read as a civic *complexio oppositorum*: the conscious city houses the victorious goddess and the defeated sea-god together, including both rival signs.

**Why it needs human amplification:** the archaeological facts are source-bearing; “complexio oppositorum” is our later interpretive appointment and needs explicit human assent before becoming a Mytheme theorem.

### Retained whole-story method

This is the first worked exemplar of the project's **whole-story-first Mytheme form**. The primary carrier is not Athena, Poseidon, the olive, the serpent, the well, the city-name or arbitration in isolation. It is the complete relational image through which those terms acquire their local offices together.

The record distinguishes three things at every stage:

1. **source recovery** — what the ancient telling or historical cultic setting gives;
2. **human-amplified relation** — a symbolic/Jungian/Symbolon reading Frank has supplied or explicitly ratified;
3. **system amplification candidate** — a relation the system can see and formulate, but which remains provisional until Frank has amplified or ratified it.

For every project interpretation, the boolean is literal:

- `human-amplified: yes` — Frank has supplied or ratified the interpretive relation. The system may deepen, source and cross-link it, but may not silently change its office.
- `human-amplified: no` — the interpretation is a system-generated candidate. It may be retained as an amplification prompt, but it may not propagate as current authorial truth until Frank has engaged it.

Source facts do **not** use this flag; they are governed by their source/claim status instead.


A whole-story Mytheme should now be able to carry, in one addressable record:

```text
SOURCE WHOLE
  telling · variants · material/historical continuation
        ↓
RELATIONAL SCENE
  every materially active figure / object / place / action / aftermath
        ↓
HUMAN AMPLIFICATION LEDGER
  human-amplified: yes/no on every interpretive edge
        ↓
JUNGIAN / SYMBOLONIC AMPLIFICATION
  only ratified edges treated as current authorial field
        ↓
SYSTEM AMPLIFICATION QUEUE
  promising but unratified readings kept visible without canonisation
        ↓
CROSS-REGISTER ROUTES
  Matheme · Episteme · etymology · argument · history · section
        ↓
DERIVED INDEXES
  figure · animal · plant · element · object · motif
        ↓
CROSS-WHOLE ARCHETYPE
  only after several intact wholes can be compared
        ↺
RETURN TO THIS WHOLE
```

This makes the Mytheme register both **human-authored and system-deepenable**. The system can recover sources, detect relations, propose amplifications and build cross-whole indexes; the boolean prevents those abilities from substituting for the human symbolic encounter that gives the project's interpretive work its actual provenance.
